ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string your apps send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and save it.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID.description: Recommended, for direct Spotify links. Create an app at [developer.spotify.com/dashboard](https://developer.spotify.com/dashboard) (tick **Web API**) and copy its Client ID. Leave empty to skip.

SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The same Spotify app's Client secret. Leave empty to skip.

YOUTUBE_API_KEY.description: Optional. A YouTube Data API v3 key from the Google Cloud console. Leave empty to skip.

CACHE.description: KV namespace for cached results; created automatically.
